scopes.allThreadAllocationScope: All JVM Java threads from before caller start snapshots through capture.close in finally; aligned caller total ends before that cleanup; subtraction is not a pure worker-allocation estimate
scopes.callerCpuScope: Current query thread only; excludes GC, JIT and other worker threads
scopes.callerPhaseScope: Up to four bounded snapshots: query start, prefix boundary, consumption end, query end; to-prefix includes prepare/evaluate; FULL consumes prefix, RETAINED may defer reads; tail includes final exhaustion hasNext and automatic cleanup, ending before explicit result/connection close; after-consume includes explicit close and retained reads; allocation then CPU then elapsed timestamp
